newsitem.title: UK: LME copper regains day's highs in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper regains day's highs in evening trade.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices recovered the day's highs during evening inter-office trade but failed to test the $2,300 a tonne level, where renewed selling is believed to lie in wait.
A firm Comex market helped the trend, dealers said, which saw three months copper trade up to around $2,290 a tonne by 1800 GMT compared with $2,268 at the close of LME floor trading at 1600 GMT.
Other metals showed barely any change.
